notes: Every cell now keeps what Kadath knows about its part in order: six storage dendrites (Knows, Usual, Trouble, Remedies, Told, History), each record a spine, with an address; an empty category is a short fine process. Pathways cross between the two halves of the brain only where real fibres do (the corpus callosum and the other commissures, the brainstem), and dendrites stay in their own half.
